#### Ubuntu: full distribution release topics, with the Base scope explicit

[24.04.5](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/ubuntu-24-04-5-lts-released/87608/) refreshes Noble installation media with accumulated security/high-severity fixes and reduced post-install downloading, across Ubuntu and official flavors. The [Base directory](https://cdimage.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-base/releases/24.04/release/) publishes all six architectures and checksums. The retrieved point-release history did not expose a complete24.04.4→.5 Base package manifest; **package-by-package/CVE completeness cannot honestly be claimed**. No kernel/desktop feature from ordinary Ubuntu installation media is silently attributed to Base.

[26.04 LTS overview](https://github.com/ubuntu/ubuntu-release-notes/blob/main/docs/26.04/summary-for-lts-users.md), [detailed changes since25.10](https://github.com/ubuntu/ubuntu-release-notes/blob/main/docs/26.04/changes-since-previous-interim.md), and [26.04.1 fixes](https://github.com/ubuntu/ubuntu-release-notes/blob/main/docs/26.04/1.md) provide the full distro-level inventory. This includes the following, regardless of app relevance:

- Desktop: updated GNOME50/apps; Snap/web search providers; accessibility/Yaru/Snap integration; Papers/Loupe/terminal/Resources/video-player replacements; new thumbnailers/LocalSearch; Wayland transition; software/update/App Center/Security Center changes; permission prompts; power and gaming improvements; ARM64 desktop media; dual-boot/JPEGXL/VA-API/codecs/update-notification/installer changes; Insights; removed GDM lifecycle scripts; color palette/GStreamer1.28/fingerprint/image sandboxing.
- Server: OpenSSH, Chrony/4.8, ClamAV, Django, PHP/8.5.2, Dovecot, Postfix, RabbitMQ, Samba/4.23 (including i386 and AD/DC upgrade behavior), Squid, SSSD, strace/6.19, HAProxy, DocumentDB, MySQL/MySQL Shell, PostgreSQL, Valkey, Exim, Kerberos, multipath-tools, OpenLDAP, Percona Toolkit, MariaDB support in main; containerd2.2.2/runc1.4/Docker29; libvirt/QEMU/EDK2; fencing/resource agents, clustering and installer changes.
- WSL: Insights, Chrony timekeeping, systemd-binfmt integration, user provisioning and Ubuntu Pro integration.
- Development: GCC15.2/binutils2.46/glibc2.43/Python3.14/Rust1.93 generation; Java25/CRaC/TCK; Spring/GraalVM/.NET10/PowerShell distribution; Rust cargo-auditable; .NET debugger/build-log tools; Zig, DPC++, CUDA and ROCm availability.
- Enterprise/cloud/security: authd/ADSys; Google Cloud/AWS/Azure changes; OpenStack2026.1; AppArmor profiles; TPM full-disk encryption; post-quantum cryptography; IntelTDX; cryptography library updates; auditable Rust dependencies; Insights consent on upgrades.
- Hardware: NVIDIA Dynamic Boost/suspend, Intel GPUs, ARM desktop, Raspberry Pi boot layout/minimal base/cloud-init swap, RISC-V RVA23S64 requirement, IBMZ minimum z15, Intel QuickAssist.
- Common system: sudo-rs/rust-coreutils, optional amd64v3 variants, Linux7.0, systemd259/259.5, Netplan1.2, APT3 history/TLS changes, Dracut, cloud-init26.1, fwupd.
- Incompatibilities/removals/deprecations: Google Drive file-manager integration and GDM PreLogin/PostSession scripts; Apache TLS1.0/1.1 defaults; NFS, SSSD, PHP, Squid and Kerberos changes; PostgreSQL i386 removal; replaced resource agents; cloud-image architecture changes; removed OpenStack features; cgroupv1 removal; removable media moved to /run/media; older IBMZ generations dropped; Java/server/component deprecations and last-release SysV systemd compatibility.
- 26.04.1 maintenance spans installer and upgrade repairs, desktop, server/cloud, kernel/hardware and base-platform fixes. Its source-linked row inventory below retains every published package/bug row, including firmware/drivers and packages absent from Base.

None of those desktop/kernel/cloud features upgrades Android's kernel, certifies proot compatibility, or implies the named package is present in the Base tarball. The actual app findings/recommended subset remain Noble24.04.5 refresh for Termux and no immediate26.04 migration.

#### Dolt release PR and issue indexes, unfiltered

This includes SQL-engine/Vitess changes not represented as individual commits in the Dolt repository, and historical issue closures. A closure entry is not independently attributed to a newly landed fix.

##### Dolt2.3.4


##### Merged PRs

* [11796](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11796): go/store/nbs: journal_writer.go: Fix a rare race where the journal_writer entered a weird state because its caller context Canceled as it was bootstraping.
* [11791](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11791): Warn about session-only checkout in noninteractive SQL
* [11790](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11790): Add virtual name indexes for tags and branches
* [11788](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11788): Persist `sql_mode` as string and reload on server startup
* [11785](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11785): Validate vector index creation without restricting schema loading
* [11782](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11782): Omit generated columns from SQL diff assignments
* [11780](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11780): Handle statement cancellation in the SQL shell
* [11772](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11772): Fix foreign keys with dropped columns
* [11755](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11755): build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.1 to 1.83.2 in /integration-tests/go-sql-server-driver
* [11303](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11303): sql: fix empty/comment-only query handling in interactive shell
* [3858](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3858): Cover vector index nullability across DDL paths
* [3857](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3857): Set return type for population statistic aggregate functions
* [3855](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3855): Implement Numeric to Date conversions
* [3852](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3852): Reject unsupported DISTINCT window aggregates
* [3847](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3847): Remove schema length check when analyzing subquery aliases
* [3845](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3845): Fix `CHAR` values differing only in trailing space to be equal
* [3841](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3841): Delimit window partition and order expressions in PartitionId
* [3840](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3840): Support pluggable UPDATE assignment evaluation
* [3836](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3836): [4/6] Test grouped windows and iterator cleanup
* [3835](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3835): [3/6] Fix user-variable strings and prepared bindings
* [3834](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3834): [2/6] Fix subquery strings and scalar alias resolution
* [3833](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3833): [1/6] Fix independent expression strings and descriptions
* [3832](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3832): Always return `transform.NewTree` when replacing `GetField` with aliased projection expression
* [3825](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3825): Support multi-byte strings and collation derivation in `LPAD` and `RPAD`
* [3824](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3824): Fix collation coercibility resolution and binary collation detection
* [3823](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3823): Fix BIGINT arithmetic overflow handling
* [3822](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3822): Fix empty inserts with generated columns
* [3820](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3820): Added DESC indexes and NULL ordering
* [3807](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3807): Fix `SELECT` list alias resolution in window clauses
* [3780](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3780): Fix EXISTS over ungrouped aggregate subqueries

##### Closed Issues

* [11399](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11399): Dolt raises an internal field-index error for sibling `SUM`/`AVG` windows
* [11396](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11396): Dolt `RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` over `BIGINT UNSIGNED` loses the current row at the lower boundary.
* [11545](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11545): Dolt swallows a child-expression evaluation error in SUM
* [11460](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11460): Dolt forms incorrect `RANGE` boundaries for a correlated computed order key
* [11425](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11425): Dolt reports an internal row-index bug for invalid `NTILE(column)`.
* [10365](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10365): dolt_tags system table missing index on tag_name - causes O(n) lookup
* [6876](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/6876): Warn users about running `dolt sql -q "call dolt_checkout(...);"`
* [11391](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11391): Dolt computes population statistical aggregates incorrectly for `INT` input.
* [11776](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11776): SET PERSIST sql_mode does not survive a sql-server restart ("value N was not found in the set")
* [10448](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10448): VECTOR INDEX: batch inserts fail with NULL embeddings after ~83 rows
* [10088](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10088): allow for times between `0000-00-00` and `0000-01-01`
* [11445](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11445): `dolt diff -r sql` emits statements that assign generated columns
* [10867](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10867): Dolt shell doesn't handle `\c`
* [10863](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10863): Do not emit warnings for empty query after trimming comments
* [10864](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10864): MySQL has error for empty delimited queries whereas Dolt has misleading warning
* [11411](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11411): Dolt arithmetic on `BIGINT UNSIGNED` values wraps into signed negative values.
* [11388](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11388): Dolt raises an internal row-index error for  empty`INSERT ()`
* [11392](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11392): Dolt silently ignores `DISTINCT` for `COUNT` and `SUM` window aggregates.
* [11747](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11747): sql-server auto-GC published a manifest whose root chunk was not preserved; only dolt_ignore'd (working-set-only) tables were lost
* [11501](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11501): Nested multi-column VIEW + self `EXISTS` → ERROR 1105 column-count mismatch
* [11464](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11464): `CHAR` PAD SPACE values split a window partition
* [11502](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11502): Dolt reaches an internal error on invalid window `ORDER BY` alias.
* [11407](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11407): `if(<cond>, <literal>, <column>)` in a WHERE over a view raises internal error
* [11741](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11741): git remotes: a cancelled push/fetch wedges sql-server indefinitely — CommandContext kills only the direct git child, and the orphaned transport holds the pipe Wait() reads
* [11508](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11508): Correlated `EXISTS` loses an empty aggregate row
* [11477](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11477): Wrong results: EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over an un-grouped aggregate subquery is mis-evaluated in a WHERE filter
* [11489](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11489): Silent data loss: EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over an un-grouped aggregate subquery corrupts DELETE/UPDATE/INSERT-SELECT/CREATE-TABLE-AS write paths (uncorrelated form deletes the whole table)
* [11380](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11380): `RPAD()/LPAD()` has unexpected behvior
* [11461](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11461): Distinct window partition/order shapes collide in `PartitionId`
##### Dolt2.3.5


##### Merged PRs

* [11842](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11842): Support wildcard table filters for binlog replication
* [11804](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11804): Enable fine-grained merging for adaptive JSON
* [11802](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/11802): Fix legacy table name unmarshalling receiver
* [3888](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3888): Fix LOAD_FILE directory handle leaks
* [3886](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3886): Simplify partial join parent for window functions in `exists` subqueries
* [3885](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3885): Support wildcard replication filter values
* [3864](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3864): Implement conversions from `DATE`, `DATETIME`, and `TIMESTAMP` to numbers
* [3863](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3863): Decorrelate inner join subqueries in `EXISTS` subqueries
* [3842](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3842): Automate dependency bump approval and merge
* [493](https://github.com/dolthub/vitess/pull/493): Add wildcard replication filter syntax
* [491](https://github.com/dolthub/vitess/pull/491): Added NULLs ordering

##### Closed Issues

* [8822](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/8822): False positive for incompatible schema change on non-ff merge when indexes on overlapping columns exist
* [11421](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11421): Dolt raises an internal row-index error for `EXISTS` with a window expression.
* [10278](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/10278): Properly handle conversions between `datetime`, `date`, and `time` types and Numeric Types
* [8275](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/8275): `SHOW CREATE` doesn't show indexes on virtual generated columns:
* [4989](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/4989): using hex string as bindvar for decimal type column in prepared statement causes panic

* [7130](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/7130): bad `double` conversion
* [7668](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/7668): `decimal.Decimal` loses precision when prepared
* [8785](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/8785): md5 function does not recognize `binary` keyword

* [8477](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/8477): dolt sql `\commit` uses static time stamp
* [8325](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/8325): panic during `dolt dump`if db contains a (non-empty) table with virtual columns

* [7402](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/7402): `dolt cherry-pick --abort` reverts ignored tables.

* [6124](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/6124): dolt diff after change primary key and adding a column gets error

##### Performance


#### Node26 stable release commit inventories

All commit entries present in the15 release bodies are retained once per SHA within each release; repeated Notable/Semver-Major/Commits listings are deduplicated. Entries include tests, docs, CI, platform fixes and dependencies regardless of app relevance. This is complete release-note coverage, not a complete4,921-commit cross-branch comparison.

### Desktop fixes

- packagekit — [2148512](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2148512) — SECURITY UPDATE: TOCTOU Race on Transaction Flags
- accountsservice — [2150215](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2150215) — d/p/0010-set-language.patch: Only write the first language to ~/.pam_environment
- gnome-session — [2150049](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2150049) — d/ubuntu-mimeapps.list: Fix default file associations for debs and snaps
- gnome-control-center — [2151253](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2151253) — d/p/u: Avoid resetting autostart toggle when changing app. When loading an app page and setting the initial widget state for the various toggles, we would be inadvertently changing the previous app's autostart setting to the current app's autostart setting
- mutter — [2147501](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2147501) — d/p/u: Avoid processing other events while waiting for snap id. Window creation is a synchronous process, so we must make sure to not process any other events while we're waiting for a response from snapd. This is achieved by using a temporary GMainContext instead of the default
- mutter — [2148049](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2148049) — d/p/u: Fix cursor spinning after launching an app
- mutter — [2148481](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2148481) — d/p/u: Fix cursor not changing in popups
- mutter — [2150242](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2150242) — d/p/u: Acknowledge the existance of non-desktop snap apps. A snap may provide some desktop apps and some CLI apps. While iterating the apps provided by the snap in search of a desktop file that matches, we should acknowledge the fact that some snap apps will have no associated desktop file. It is otherwise considered a programming error to try and access a json member that does not exist
- mutter — [2148655](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2148655) — d/p: Cherry-pick Upstream Fix for crash on hot-plugging similar monitors
- mutter — [2149823](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2149823) — d/p: Fix gdctl crash on invalid backlight
- gnome-session — [2077969](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2077969) — d/control: Have ubuntu-session depend on gnome-shell-ubuntu-extensions. ubuntu-session is the package providing the option to log-in as the Ubuntu session running `gnome-shell --mode=ubuntu`, which attempts to load the Ubuntu extensions. Thus, it would be appropriate to add a direct dependency to the extensions package here, rather than relying soley on the ubuntu-desktop-minimal metapackage
- mutter — [2151278](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2151278) — d/p: Fix same-window drag-and-drop on touchscreen

- resources — [2151297](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2151297) — d/p: Read localized app names from langpacks. Many apps installed as deb packages provide localization for their app names, short description, etc. in langpacks. Resources did not support fetching these strings from langpacks. Use the existing implementation in GLib 2.0 to parse the localized strings
- libreoffice — [2155241](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2155241) — New upstream release

- packagekit — [2148474](https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2148474) — d/p: Honour allow_deps=false when removing packages. The PackageKit API allows restricting a RemovePackages transaction to prevent removing any dependent packages, but the APT backend was not honouring it. This could have lead to the accidental removal of system packages when trying to uninstall applications from simple PackageKit frontends

Currently only `software-properties-livepatch` is supported, which is fine for Noble but not for Resolute onward, because `desktop-security-center` snap is used instead. This patch adds support for the later, checking for it first and falling back to the old `software-properties` code if needed

<summary>OpenCode 1, OpenCode 2, Paseo and Codex: all release changes and commits</summary>

### Full runtime change inventory, separate from the recommended subset

This inventory intentionally includes desktop, TUI, web/Console, other operating systems, documentation, dependencies, build machinery, tests, generated files and release maintenance. Inclusion does not imply that OpenCode Mobile implements or benefits from a change. The earlier component notes and upgrade-now list select the app-relevant subset. Commit subjects below are upstream metadata, linked individually to the complete commits; they are not claims that every commit changes the phone product.

#### OpenCode 1 release-level inventory

Sources: [1.18.30](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.18.30), [1.18.31](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.18.31), [1.18.32](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.18.32). The complete 104-commit ledger below also includes changes omitted from release highlights.

- **1.18.30 — runtime/models:** Introduces the GPT-6 Astra prompt; retains fully qualified Bedrock DeepSeek identifiers, including ARNs; refreshes Azure and OpenAI provider packages; exposes supported GitLab GPT/Claude reasoning choices. **Hosted Console:** Normalizes OpenAI usage and adjusts configurable tier thresholds.
- **1.18.31 — runtime/ACP:** Restores session model, effort and mode plus reasoning boundaries across loading/resuming/forking. **TUI:** Authentication failures while fetching remote configuration become visible startup failures. **Provider extension:** Copilot requests use summarized adaptive thinking. **Console/UI/dependencies:** Adds batch workspace-block operations, updates the gateway SDK, and supplies a Merge Gateway provider icon.
- **1.18.32 — runtime/providers:** Corrects Bedrock image placement according to model family and restores Together AI streamed usage. **Hosted model offerings/docs:** Adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.7 information/offerings. The underlying compare additionally includes Node npm-entrypoint resolution, filesystem import-cycle repair and hosted inference authentication; see their individual ledger entries rather than assuming all fixes run inside the installed server.

#### OpenCode 2 release/tag inventory

The npm-stable interval contains 2.0.11–2.0.18. `gh release view v2.0.18` returned no GitHub release object, so a release-highlights page cannot serve as a complete inventory. The [tag comparison](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/compare/v2.0.10...v2.0.18), exact tag-tree diff and **all 284 commit subjects below** are the inventory. Nothing is excluded for low mobile relevance.

- **Core/server/protocol:** Console policy enforcement; shared child prompt-cache affinity; session HTTP-hook execution; MCP OAuth login behavior and error reporting; branch/subdirectory Git-plugin installation; session metadata updates and its durable event; projects ordered by recent activity; direct and one-time pairing links; session tokens/cookies; provider-account metadata; websocket idle/chunk timeouts; richer shell exit/output/limit reporting; provider streaming fragment boundaries and delta publication order; legacy tool rename guidance during migration; MCP resources exposed to Code Mode; Console-hosted MCP registration; model-limit/compaction work including explicit reversions; decoding old media in compaction checkpoints; session/provider catalog refreshes.
- **AI/providers/media:** Budget/effort variants and limits for Anthropic, Alibaba, Bedrock and OpenRouter; Vertex tool-call IDs and keepalives; Kimi reasoning and tool schemas; Gemini tool schema handling; Responses-only Copilot routing; GPT verbosity defaults and Sol/Luna prompt-cache preservation; provider error decoding; OpenAI PDF treatment; image assets and generation; queued image/video execution; speech generation and transcription; client/media facade revisions; provider options and usage/cost accounting; Runway cancellation behavior; deadlines, timestamp options, streaming transcript parsing, TTS WAV and image-output settings. Changes and reversions are both retained in the ledger.
- **Code Mode/runtime language:** Cancellation propagation and tool execution context; source error locations; whole-word search ranking and prefixed namespaces; synchronous search guidance; closest-tool diagnostics; JS built-ins, coercion and iterator behavior; promises, generators, functions, `this`/`arguments`, property keys, Map/Set/WeakMap/WeakSet, tagged strings, byte arrays, Object operations, clone behavior, error inheritance and primitive conversion; support-matrix documentation and expanded conformance tests.
- **CLI/TUI:** Startup/upgrade/API errors and redacted debug configuration; Windows upgrade/uninstall contention; tab/session menu and project-dialog behavior; sidebar onboarding and MCP persistence; session export; provider/Console sign-in; font/color/theme details; composer/module-cycle repairs; transcript mounting/history/scroll anchors; optional verbosity and its revert/reintroduction; tool failure details; fs.watch resource errors; large-diff virtualization; model variant hooks; undo of queued prompts into the input; storage watcher handling and OpenTUI updates.
- **Web/app/desktop:** Browser pane navigation/state and visibility; timeline alignment and model-switch scroll retention; touch attachment controls, file previews and rich artifact tabs; side-question panel; settings navigation/project management; agent/session path and metadata displays; browser/device/Console pairing and sign-in; mobile bottom navigation; nested tabs; provider account switching; theme contrast/tokens; updater identification; Electron dependency update and macOS DMG-signing change.
- **Operations/content:** Console/model/budget/inference documentation, multilingual coverage, pricing/catalog changes, Nix hash updates, dependency and OpenTelemetry patches, Bun caching and Windows CI fixes, generated snapshots, unit/e2e fixtures and release synchronization. The following ledger preserves the exact individual changes and every maintenance commit.

#### Paseo 0.9.2 complete release-level inventory

Source: [0.9.2 release](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/releases/tag/v0.9.2); the complete 55-commit interval follows below.

- **Configuration/launch:** Claude session and plugin setup can supply structured extra launch options.
- **Efficiency:** Unobservable Git repositories do less background polling; directory suggestions scan large home folders faster.
- **Daemon/file observation:** Prevents a hang when new ignored directories appear after opening a workspace; frees connection-associated memory when clients leave.
- **Projects/worktrees:** Handles trailing-space directory names during load; obtains workspace labels even before sidebar initialization; retains unavailable disk/share workspaces; allows recovery after archived-worktree import failures; reads archived logs after worktree removal; clears inherited upstream behavior that could push a newly created branch into the default branch; retains fork PR associations across refresh; rejects missing/file paths where a local workspace directory is required.
- **Chat/forms/mobile/voice:** Preserves legal upload filename characters; keeps selected multi-choice values and freeform Other input; Android Back closes an open bottom sheet correctly; avoids interleaving the voice thinking cue between spoken segments.
- **Claude:** Keeps attachment-bearing slash commands as commands; supports rewind after unanswered turns and after subagent-containing turns; includes configured Fable models in selection.
- **History and providers:** Prevents duplicate replay with durable timeline storage; OMP custom messages no longer prematurely finish a turn; stopped OMP turns settle as stopped rather than failed; cancel can settle Pi/OMP sessions after their runtime exits; OpenCode agents honor permission configuration; Codex default/read-only permissions no longer route into Auto-review; Cursor can switch away from a Fast-capable model without breaking creation; Codex Sol/Luna expose their Fast controls; daemon-launched ACP terminals keep the correct agent identity.
- **Plugins/Hub:** Preserves completed plugin-session status after restart; handles reload during provider shutdown without crashing the subprocess; contains failed plugin requests instead of crashing the daemon; Hub-created workspaces can receive titles.
- **Startup/configuration:** Tolerates malformed schedule input without preventing daemon launch; handles empty PID files and reboot-recycled process IDs; reads BOM-prefixed JSON configuration; includes background startup failures in the reported log; identifies the offending file/field for invalid configuration; password rejection no longer produces misleading start-daemon advice.
- **Desktop/CLI/cache/accounts:** Password-protected desktop connections retain Open in editor; JSON permission listings retain full request IDs for allow/deny; repeated replica-store write rejection does not spin a read loop; inactive MiniMax token subscriptions receive appropriate account presentation.
- **Keyboard:** Accepts modified Backspace custom bindings; preserves multi-step shortcut execution across an app update; recognizes modified second steps; custom pane-focus bindings work while typing.

#### Codex complete stable-release highlight inventory

All seven stable Rust CLI releases between the declared 0.153.4 contract and 0.157.1 are represented. The 1,116-commit ledger additionally covers changes that release highlights do not mention. Release highlights sometimes describe a wider base than this patch baseline; the exact commit interval, not the highlight's historical base, determines the ledger.

**[0.154.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.154.0)**

- **Models/workflows:** Adds GPT-6 Astra to the picker and Bedrock catalog; introduces experimental managed worktrees for new/forked sessions plus browsing/resume; supports answering questions inline while work continues, with choices/freeform text and draft preservation.
- **Windows:** Adds shared background-server operation, lifecycle management and managed updates.
- **TUI:** Vim replace mode gains undo/repeat and improved legacy-terminal Escape handling; copied responses keep rich-text formatting, and copy commands can target status/session fields.
- **Plugins/MCP:** Refreshes tools, skills and hooks after external plugin changes; coordinates OAuth refresh and preserves login challenges without automatically retrying rejected tool executions.
- **Trust/sandbox:** Avoids invoking workspace-controlled PATH helpers before trust; blocks terminal-input injection through the macOS sandbox.
- **Resume/defaults/approval:** Keeps saved permissions during remote resume/fork; honors server model defaults for fresh/forked sessions; renders conversations held by another app read-only with retry and retained drafts; maintains authorization context through compaction and invalidates approvals contradicted by later user input.
- **Documentation/removed command:** Refreshes bundled Astra guidance; removes the deprecated `codex mcp-server` command.

**[0.155.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.155.0)**

- **Voice/TUI:** Adds experimental live-transcript voice sessions with microphone controls; displays reasoning summaries during work and completion times afterward; repairs tmux resize handling, viewport restoration and thread-switch stale history.
- **Agents/worktrees:** Provides task hide/archive/delete operations plus ownership information and confirmation for clean managed-worktree deletion.
- **macOS/security:** Adds Touch ID verification for supported local MCP requests; hardens shell snapshots against credential leaks and prevents Windows escapes from restricted WSL environments.
- **Daemon/Bedrock:** Allows update schedules and explicit daemon updates, restoring stored threads/goals after restart; accepts command-provided AWS credentials with cached refresh and recovery.
- **Reliability/auth:** Persists accepted prompts despite pre-turn compaction failure; reports stale MCP OAuth accurately; improves automatic-review action/evidence retention, transient retries and error classification; drops previous-account remote sessions/websocket caches/catalogs when identities change.
- **Publishing:** Coordinates Python SDK/runtime versions with stable CLI releases and checks runtime assets before publication.

**[0.155.1](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.155.1)**

- **Provider compatibility:** New local TUI sessions no longer enable reasoning summaries implicitly, avoiding provider rejection while preserving explicit configuration.

**[0.156.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.156.0)**

- **TUI/visuals:** Adds optional fullscreen browsing with transcript search, mouse selection and right-click copy; six themes, Mermaid rendering and mathematical layout; fixes tmux/SSH clipboard forwarding and pasted tab preservation.
- **Voice:** Enables voice by default with F8/settings and Linux/Windows audio runtimes; preserves speech across playback pauses and bursty input.
- **Account/agents/worktrees:** Adds usage/token/plugin/skill analytics; status filtering and worktree creation in the agent overview; turns worktree support on by default.
- **Daemon:** Offers an update UI and bypass option for the local background server.
- **Conversation correctness:** Retains streamed answers/plans on turn failure, interruption and subagent completion; restores Plan mode on resume and preserves thread identity/settings when earlier prompts are edited.
- **Authentication/security:** Recovers login through proxies and handles temporary OAuth-discovery failures; closes Windows inbound-network isolation gaps, privileged Linux/macOS socket exposure and writes through read-only macOS handles.
- **Docs/dependencies:** Documents obsolete personality settings and one-character network wildcard semantics; refreshes TLS packages, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 in musl builds.

**[0.156.1](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.156.1)**

- **Models/quota:** Adds Sol/Luna choices and recommends Luna in the rate-limit switch flow.

**[0.157.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.157.0)**

- **Models:** Adds Sol/Luna with Bedrock support and migration suggestions.
- **TUI:** Makes fullscreen transcripts the default; supports Shift-click selection extension; improves list/checklist and aligned-math rendering; respects tmux mouse configuration and uses native Terminal.app scrollback over SSH in automatic mode.
- **Daemon/workflows:** Automatically starts eligible background servers and offers recovery for incompatible settings; adds a fork shortcut for conversations locked by another app while keeping drafts/queued prompts; enables imports for remote and local-daemon sessions.
- **Voice/questions:** Keeps active voice conversations when switching threads; returns unsent answers to the composer without disturbing history search.
- **Network/uploads/security:** Applies configured proxies to realtime and standalone search, including redirects; retries transient uploads and increases timeout; enforces access policy throughout redirects and established HTTP/WebSocket activity, cancelling traffic after revocation.

**[0.157.1](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.157.1)**

- Upstream published no determined release highlights: its release-note generator reported an empty PR index and failed tag comparison. This is an evidence limitation, not evidence of zero changes. The verified overall commit inventory remains included below.

<summary>Direct pub dependencies: every newer stable changelog entry</summary>

### Full published change inventory: direct pub packages

This inventory includes **every changelog entry in each newer stable release**, including features and fixes outside this app's current Android path. It is separate from the recommended upgrade subset and app-impact analysis above. Entries are paraphrased and grouped only where they describe the same change; nothing is excluded for low relevance. Versions already resolved to latest have an empty interval, recorded below. This is a complete inventory of the published release-note entries, not a claim that release notes enumerate every undocumented repository commit or transitive change.

#### file_picker: 12.2.0 → 13.1.0 (three releases)

**12.3.0**

- Windows gains `WindowsOptions.acceptLabel` to customize confirmation text in single/multi-file, directory and save dialogs.
- macOS gains `DarwinOptions.acceptLabel` for single/multi-file selection through `NSOpenPanel.prompt`; the option does not change iOS behavior.

**13.0.0**

- `PlatformFile.length()` becomes nullable (`Future<int?>`): unknown/failed metadata is null, while an empty file is still zero. It now agrees with nullable `lengthSync()`.
- Removes deprecated `pickFiles()` selection/read arguments: `allowMultiple`, `withData`, `withReadStream`, `readSequential`. Use single-file `pickFile()` and file read methods instead.
- Removes top-level `lockParentWindow` from file/directory/save dialogs; configure the Windows/Linux option objects.
- Removes top-level `cancelUploadOnWindowBlur` from file selection; use `WebOptions`.
- Removes `androidSafOptions` from file/directory selection; use `androidOptions`.
- Raises minimum federated-package versions together: platform interface 4.0.0; Android/Darwin/Linux/Windows implementations 2.0.0; web 4.0.0.
- Web sequential-reading configuration begins taking effect correctly.
- Android/iOS delete obsolete native branches for eager `withData` handling.

**13.1.0** adds iOS UIScene integration. [Complete release notes](https://pub.dev/packages/file_picker/versions/13.1.0/changelog).

#### flutter_secure_storage: 11.0.0 → 11.2.0 (three releases)

**11.1.0**

- Adds `checkUpgradeStatus()` to identify data lost when users skip a required intermediate major migration.
- Moves the encrypted/wrapped key correctly when changing between historical `sharedPreferencesName` and `storageNamespace` configuration.
- Android stops hardcoding compileSdk 37 and inherits Flutter's compile SDK (36 at that release).
- Requires platform-interface 2.1.0 or later for the new status method.

**11.1.1** fixes Android key-cipher selection by consulting the stored cipher marker instead of a `KeyCipher.toString()` representation.

**11.2.0**

- Adds Android `requireBiometricsPerOperation` configuration.
- Dismissing a biometric prompt with its negative button no longer hangs the operation.
- A fresh biometric installation using the default/non-namespaced store no longer crashes.
- Ports fixes for multiple storage instances sharing cryptographic keys to the 11.x branch.
- Recovers biometric-protected storage when cipher initialization/use fails after successful authentication.
- Recovers the biometric application key across a namespace change.
- Restricts Android `deleteAll` to matching key prefixes instead of wiping the complete backing preferences file.
- Darwin keychain retrieval searches across accessibility settings.
- Pending namespace recovery no longer produces a false data-loss result in `checkUpgradeStatus()`.

The 10.3.2/10.3.3/10.3.4 backports released later in calendar time are below the installed 11.0.0 and are not additional versions on this forward upgrade path. [Complete release notes and individual commit links](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_secure_storage/versions/11.2.0/changelog).

#### mobile_scanner: 7.4.0 → 7.4.2 (two releases)

**7.4.1**

- Web ZXing-Wasm backend updates 3.1.1→3.1.3.
- Android uses the current orientation when restarting after the device rotated while scanning was stopped.
- Android detects rotation despite early display callbacks and seamless 180-degree landscape changes.
- Every Android analyzer exit releases its frame, including null-image, cancelled/failed ML Kit, input-construction and callback-error paths; an abandoned frame can no longer freeze future decoding.
- CameraX startup errors are returned to the error callback/UI rather than crashing the app.
- Kotlin DSL plus built-in-Kotlin detection removes the false AGP 9 KGP warning while retaining older-build compatibility.
- Adds ProGuard retention for internal ML Kit barcode classes.
- Apple stops capture before engine destruction and frees the camera on detach, preventing an in-flight-frame use-after-destruction crash.
- Web removes redundant `@JS` constructor annotations rejected by Dart 3.14/Flutter 3.48.
- Fixes post-`switchCamera()` rotation tracking: cancelling the old orientation subscription no longer destroys the newly created channel.

**7.4.2** postpones Android orientation-sensor subscription until camera start. [Complete release notes](https://pub.dev/packages/mobile_scanner/versions/7.4.2/changelog).

#### sherpa_onnx: 1.13.7 → 1.13.8 (one release)

**1.13.8** includes all 18 published entries:

1. Adds segment confidence to Java/Kotlin offline diarization bindings (#3943).
2. Makes CI downloads retry and validate their results (#3941).
3. Enables Rust examples in Android Termux (#3942).
4. Updates ONNX Runtime to 1.28.2 (#3935).
5. Exposes diarization confidence in Go (#3936).
6. Adds Windows-arm64 Go API support (#3934).
7. Adds the underlying per-segment offline-diarization confidence computation (#3881).
8. Adds Intel NPU execution through OpenVINO (#3910).
9. Repairs Canary's empty transcript when its first decoded token is end-of-sequence (#3920).
10. Suppresses silent-input hallucinations in FunASR-Nano (#3921).
11. Suppresses silent-input hallucinations in Moonshine v2 (#3923).
12. Suppresses silent-input hallucinations in Cohere Transcribe (#3924).
13. Provides Nabra-82M Arabic TTS conversion scripts targeting Kokoro (#3898).
14. Adds Kokoro 1.0's `em_santa` voice (#3928).
15. Enables Python use in Android Termux (#3922).
16. Supports building directly in an Android Termux terminal (#3916).
17. Removes a shared-random-generator race in FunASR-Nano/Qwen3-ASR offline recognition (#3912).
18. Publishes the quantized Nabra 82M Arabic TTS model (#3933).

[Complete release notes](https://pub.dev/packages/sherpa_onnx/versions/1.13.8/changelog). These are included even though current app dictation uses CPU Whisper, not the newly fixed models or TTS/diarization features.

#### qr: 3.0.2 → 4.0.0 (one release)

**4.0.0**

- Removes exported `QrBitBuffer` and `QrCode.dataCache`.
- Replaces integer error-correction constants with enum cases `low/medium/quartile/high`; constructors/properties consume that enum.
- Makes `QrCode` immutable, removing its `addData/addByteData/addNumeric/addAlphaNumeric/addECI` mutators.
- Replaces `fromData/fromUint8List/fromPayload` constructors with one factory accepting payload, correction level and optional minimum type number.
- Generalizes public typed-byte arguments to `TypedData`.
- Prevents subclassing via `final` on QrCode, QrImage, QrPayload, QrValidationResult and InputTooLongException.
- Adds `QrPayload`: string/typed-data constructors and multipart string/typed-data/numeric/alphanumeric/ECI accumulation methods.
- Adds `QrEciValue` and ECI payload support.
- Adds `QrValidationResult` and its payload factory for validation/configuration prediction.
- Automatically chooses an encoding mode for added/constructed strings.
- Throws `InputTooLongException` above version 40's capacity instead of generating an invalid code.
- Reports approximately 50% faster QrImage and 40% faster large-code generation.
- Raises minimum Dart to3.11.

[Complete release notes](https://pub.dev/packages/qr/versions/4.0.0/changelog). Performance percentages are upstream results, not measurements of this app.

#### cross_file: 0.3.5+5 → 0.4.0 (one release)

**0.4.0**

- Reorganizes into a package-separated federated Flutter plugin.
- Adds `XDirectory` for resource containers, filesystem `FileSystemXFile/FileSystemXDirectory`, and ephemeral scoped-storage `ScopedStorageXFile/ScopedStorageXDirectory` implementations.
- Replaces `XFile(path)` construction with `XFile.fileSystem(path:...)` or `FileSystemXFile(path)`.
- Removes `XFile.fromData`; web callers can construct scoped-storage creation parameters from a Blob/File through `WebScopedStorageXFileCreationParams.fromBlob`.
- Removes `saveTo`; filesystem files gain `writeAsBytes`, and web gains a scoped-storage download extension.
- Removes `mimeType`.
- Replaces general `path` with `uri`; filesystem-specific `path` remains available on that subtype.
- Changes synchronous `name` property into an asynchronous name method.
- Adds a Flutter SDK dependency and raises minima to Flutter 3.41/Dart 3.11.

[Complete release notes](https://pub.dev/packages/cross_file/versions/0.4.0/changelog). Inventorying these changes does not remove the plugin constraint conflicts documented above.

#### Primary packages with no newer stable release

The complete newer-release interval is empty for each of: **shorebird_code_push 2.0.7, record 7.1.1, flutter_svg 2.3.0, xml 7.0.1, image_picker 1.2.3, desktop_drop 0.8.4, flutter_timezone 5.1.0, crypto 3.0.7, path_provider 2.1.6, scrollable_positioned_list 0.3.8**. Each resolved version equals latest stable in its registry response cited in the table; the earlier component notes explicitly label any historical changes already installed. Flutter SDK components remain attached to the mandatory Flutter pin; the local generated opencode_sdk has no independent published upgrade interval.

#### Complete newer-release inventory: secondary direct Dart packages

This inventory includes **every published changelog entry** between the worktree's lockfile resolution and the latest stable release for these packages, including documentation, test-only, desktop and otherwise unused changes. It is separate from the recommended subset. Counts use newer stable versions, not the lower bound of a caret range; unreleased branches and historical changes already in the lockfile are outside this version interval.

**Dio 5.11.0 → 5.11.1: one newer stable release, published 2026-09-04.** All three 5.11.1 entries:

1. Pausing a response stream now pauses its source socket subscription. Previously network input continued accumulating in memory despite downstream pause, with possible OOM on constrained devices.
2. The upstream certificate-pinning test now selects a fingerprint guaranteed not to match its served certificate. This removes reliance on different badssl.com hosts serving different certificates and makes that test deterministic; it is a test repair rather than a new runtime certificate-validation feature.
3. Classes declaring `implements Interceptor` no longer fail with `NoSuchMethodError` when entering the interceptor pipeline. The pipeline had invoked private dispatch members supplied by inheritance, which interface implementers do not inherit.

There are no other entries in the published 5.11.1 changelog and its Unreleased section is empty. [5.11.1 published changelog](https://pub.dev/packages/dio/versions/5.11.1/changelog), [registry history](https://pub.dev/api/packages/dio).


**clock 1.1.2 → 1.1.3: one newer stable release, published 2026-08-28.** The sole entry is preservation of the original microsecond component when calculating `monthsAgo`, `monthsFromNow` and `yearsAgo`. No other published change is listed. [1.1.3 changelog](https://pub.dev/packages/clock/versions/1.1.3/changelog), [registry history](https://pub.dev/api/packages/clock).


**dynamic_color 1.9.0 → 2.1.0: four newer stable releases, all published 2026-08-20.** Complete chronological inventory:

- **2.0.0:** changes the Material dependency to `material_ui` 1.0.0 and raises the minimum `material_color_utilities` version to 0.13.0. This changes the `ColorScheme` type returned by palette conversion to the type supplied by `material_ui`.
- **2.0.1:** repairs the README hyperlink for `ColorScheme.fromImageProvider`; documentation-only change.
- **2.0.2:** changes Android plugin setup so the Kotlin Android plugin is explicitly applied only when the Android Gradle Plugin major version is below 9. This accommodates the AGP 9 built-in Kotlin setup while preserving older AGP behavior. [Upstream issue #695](https://github.com/material-foundation/flutter-packages/issues/695).
- **2.1.0:** adds Linux accent-color retrieval through the XDG Desktop Portal Settings interface.

No iOS, web, security/CVE, or additional performance changes are listed in these four release sections. [Complete 2.1.0 changelog](https://pub.dev/packages/dynamic_color/versions/2.1.0/changelog), [registry release history](https://pub.dev/api/packages/dynamic_color), [published archive including conversion and Android build scripts](https://pub.dev/api/archives/dynamic_color-2.1.0.tar.gz).


**Empty newer-stable intervals:** flutter_riverpod 3.4.3, shared_preferences 2.5.5, url_launcher 6.3.2, uuid 4.6.0, xterm 4.0.0, package_info_plus 10.2.1, window_manager 0.5.2, screen_retriever 0.2.2, path 1.9.1, intl 0.20.3, cupertino_icons 1.0.9, highlight 0.7.0, flutter_lints 6.0.0, and shared_preferences_platform_interface 2.4.2 all equal the latest stable version returned by their pub.dev package APIs. Their **complete pinned-to-latest delta is therefore empty**; older features described in the component notes are already installed, not omitted upgrade changes.
